format: stands/15-scenarios (A4 modal: a page, probes in steps); the runner is tests/browser/manifest-probes.browser.mjs

body: <sf-list-description id="facts" label="Сведения о сайте"><script type="application/json" data-sf-settings>{"items": [{"id": "address", "label": "Адрес", "value": "demo-static.test", "href": "#site"}, {"id": "root", "label": "Корень сайта", "value": "/var/www/demo-static/public", "mono": true, "copy": true}, {"id": "php", "label": "PHP", "value": 8.3}, {"id": "cert", "label": "Сертификат", "value": "Действует до 12 декабря", "status": "success", "hint": "Продлевается сам"}, {"id": "owner", "label": "Владелец", "value": "", "copy": true, "href": "#owner"}, {"value": "без подписи"}]}</script></sf-list-description>

<sf-list-description id="record"><script type="application/json" data-sf-settings>{"label": "Заказ", "dividers": true, "items": [{"type": "section", "id": "order", "label": "Заказ", "action": {"label": "Изменить", "event": "edit"}}, {"id": "n", "label": "Номер", "value": "10482", "copy": true}, {"id": "s", "label": "Статус", "badge": {"text": "Передан", "status": "info"}}, {"type": "section", "id": "customer", "label": "Покупатель", "action": {"label": "Изменить"}}, {"id": "name", "label": "Имя покупателя полностью", "value": "Анна Королёва", "help": "Как в паспорте"}, {"id": "comment", "label": "Комментарий", "value": "", "status": "warning", "action": {"label": "Указать", "event": "fill"}}, {"id": "date", "label": "Дата", "value": "", "empty": "Не назначена"}, {"id": "sum", "label": "Сумма", "value": 12480}, {"id": "bs", "label": "Сбой", "status": "error", "badge": {"text": "Сбой", "status": "error"}}]}</script></sf-list-description>

probes.title: a dl of label and value pairs in the host's order; an item without a label is left out; an empty value says «Не указан» with no link and no copy; a status is said in words

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#facts'); const root = el.querySelector('.sf-list-description'); const rows = [...el.querySelectorAll('dl > .sf-list-description-row')]; const owner = el.querySelector('[data-id=owner]'); return root.getAttribute('role') === 'group' && root.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Сведения о сайте' && rows.map((row) => row.dataset.id).join(',') === 'address,root,php,cert,owner' && rows.every((row) => row.querySelector(':scope > dt') && row.querySelector(':scope > dd')) && el.querySelector('[data-id=php] .sf-list-description-text').textContent === '8.3' && owner.querySelector('.sf-list-description-empty').textContent === 'Не указан' && !owner.querySelector('a, sf-button-copy') && el.querySelector('[data-id=cert] .sr-only').textContent === 'В порядке: ' && el.querySelector('[data-id=cert] .sf-list-description-hint').textContent === 'Продлевается сам' && el.querySelector('[data-id=root] .sf-list-description-text--mono') !== null; })()

probes.title: a value with href is a link; its press asks sf-list-description-navigate, cancelable
copy adds an sf-button-copy of the value, named by the label

steps.check: (() => { const copy = document.querySelector('#facts [data-id=root] sf-button-copy'); return document.querySelectorAll('#facts sf-button-copy').length === 1 && copy.getAttribute('value') === '/var/www/demo-static/public' && copy.getAttribute('label') === 'Скопировать: Корень сайта'; })()

probes.title: columns put every value on one axis beside its label; stacked, and auto in a narrow column, put the label over the value

steps.check: (() => { const box = (el) => el.getBoundingClientRect(); const values = [...document.querySelectorAll('#facts dd')].map((dd) => Math.round(box(dd).left)); const label = box(document.querySelector('#facts [data-id=address] dt')); const value = box(document.querySelector('#facts [data-id=address] dd')); const over = (id) => { const dt = box(document.querySelector(`#${id} dt`)); const dd = box(document.querySelector(`#${id} dd`)); return dd.top >= dt.bottom - 0.5 && Math.abs(dd.left - dt.left) < 0.5; }; return new Set(values).size === 1 && value.left > label.right && Math.abs(value.top - label.top) < 0.5 && over('stacked') && over('narrow'); })()

probes.title: overflow truncate keeps a value on one line with its whole text as title; focus shows it whole

steps.check: (() => { const text = document.querySelector('#cut .sf-list-description-text'); return text.scrollWidth > text.clientWidth && text.getAttribute('title').length > 60 && text.tabIndex === 0 && text.getBoundingClientRect().height <= parseFloat(getComputedStyle(text).lineHeight) + 0.5; })()

probes.title: with no items it draws nothing; a new list draws again
section items: a head per section (role heading, its action named «Изменить: <section>»), a dl per section named by it; one label column for the whole record, every value on one axis

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#record'); const heads = [...el.querySelectorAll('.sf-list-description-head')]; const parts = [...el.querySelectorAll('dl.sf-list-description-part')]; const left = (q) => [...el.querySelectorAll(q)].map((n) => Math.round(n.getBoundingClientRect().left)); const dd = new Set(left('dd')); const dt = new Set(left('dt')); const title = heads[0].querySelector('[role=heading]'); const button = heads[0].querySelector('sf-button'); return heads.length === 2 && parts.length === 2 && parts[1].getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Покупатель' && title.getAttribute('aria-level') === '3' && title.textContent.trim() === 'Заказ' && button.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Изменить: Заказ' && dd.size === 1 && dt.size === 1; })()

probes.title: an empty value says «Не указан» (or the item's empty words), draws no status (the defect: the icon before «—»), and carries the item's action «Указать»; a press asks apply {action, scope: entry, ids, id, kind}

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#record'); const c = el.querySelector('[data-id=comment]'); const d = el.querySelector('[data-id=date]'); return c.querySelector('.sf-list-description-empty').textContent === 'Не указан' && !c.querySelector('.sf-list-description-icon, .sr-only') && !c.hasAttribute('data-status') && c.querySelector('.sf-list-description-action sf-button').getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Указать: Комментарий' && d.querySelector('.sf-list-description-empty').textContent === 'Не назначена'; })()

probes.title: a badge value is an sf-badge on the value's line (line = the list's size); help puts an sf-help-mark after the label; a number is in tabular figures; a row with a status and a badge draws the badge only (one mark)

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#record'); const badge = el.querySelector('[data-id=s] sf-badge'); const help = el.querySelector('[data-id=name] dt sf-help-mark'); const sum = el.querySelector('[data-id=sum] .sf-list-description-text'); return badge && badge.getAttribute('line') === '1' && badge.getAttribute('status') === 'info' && help && help.getAttribute('text') === 'Как в паспорте' && help.getAttribute('label') === 'Подробнее: Имя покупателя полностью' && sum.classList.contains('sf-list-description-text--numeric') && getComputedStyle(sum).fontVariantNumeric.includes('tabular-nums') && el.querySelector('[data-id=bs] sf-badge') !== null && !el.querySelector('[data-id=bs] .sf-list-description-icon, [data-id=bs] .sr-only') && !el.querySelector('[data-id=bs]').hasAttribute('data-status'); })()

probes.title: layout grid: each label over its value, at most columns per row, a value on one line with an ellipsis and its whole text as title

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#grid'); const rows = [...el.querySelectorAll('.sf-list-description-row')]; const tops = new Set(rows.map((r) => Math.round(r.getBoundingClientRect().top))); const firstRow = rows.filter((r) => Math.round(r.getBoundingClientRect().top) === Math.round(rows[0].getBoundingClientRect().top)); const dt = rows[0].querySelector('dt').getBoundingClientRect(); const dd = rows[0].querySelector('dd').getBoundingClientRect(); const long = el.querySelector('[data-id=c] .sf-list-description-text'); return firstRow.length === 3 && tops.size === 2 && dd.top >= dt.bottom - 0.5 && long.scrollWidth > long.clientWidth && long.getAttribute('title').startsWith('Москва'); })()
